# Progress Ayere

## Who I Am
Progress Ayere is a Frontend Developer based in Lagos, Nigeria.

## What I Do
I specialize in building fast, interactive, and conversion-focused web experiences using React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Web3 technologies. I also work with Framer Motion and GSAP for motion design systems.

## Services
- Web3 Frontend Development (Solana, blockchain-based platforms)
- Landing Pages & Marketing Sites
- Interactive Dashboards
- Motion Design Systems
- React & Next.js Application Development

## Notable Projects
- **Ghonsi Proof** (https://ghonsiproof.com) — Blockchain-based credential verification platform built on Solana. Frontend built with Next.js 15 App Router.
- **Blockchain on Campus (BCC)** (https://bcc-yct.vercel.app) — A blockchain education community platform serving students across campuses in Nigeria.
- **PCC Services** (https://pcc-services.vercel.app) — Portfolio and services website built for an architect client. Features project showcases, 3D design galleries, and construction project listings. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

## Tech Stack
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Solidity, Node.js, Supabase, SQL

## Location
Lagos, Nigeria. Available for remote work globally.

## Availability
Open for freelance and contract projects. Average response time: under 24 hours.
